parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: Show that the SІ base units of power are kg m^{2} s^{-3}.
parts.question_text_latex: Show that the SІ base units of power are kg $m^{2}$ $s^{-3}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The rate of flow of thermal energy Q
t in a material is given by
Q =(CAT)/(x)
where A is the cross-sectional area of the material,
T is the temperature difference across the thickness of the material,
x is the thickness of the material,
C is a constant.
Determine the SІ base units of C.
base units
